Missing alt text value Focus on what you want to build. Let Advisor handle IAM, billing alerts, and security baselines. [...] ## What is AWS Startup Advisor?

AWS Startup Advisor is your AI-powered build assistant, available as an extension for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, and Kiro or as a standalone experience on the web. It gives you and your coding agents tailored guidance on AI, architecture, costs, credits, security, and migration, matched to your startup's stack and stage. Whether you're starting from an idea or moving an existing app to AWS, it meets you where you build and adapts its recommendations as your startup grows. AWS Startup Advisor doesn't store your code or share your data with third parties.

## How does it work? [...] ## How does it work?

AWS Startup Advisor picks up where your AWS Activate Credit application leaves off. It uses your application data and your startup’s website to understand your stack and stage. From there, it delivers guidance through a skills-based experience: scaffold an architecture, optimize costs, set up your environment, migrate to AWS, or deploy an AI agent. Each step is shaped by what you’re actually building.

## How much does it cost?

AWS Startup Advisor is available at no additional charge. You pay only for the AWS resources you or your agent provisions or interacts with, at standard AWS pricing.
